## History

Shirley resigned from her position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) after [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) moved in to keep [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) company. During her summer vacation, she spent time visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her student [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), where she noticed the despondency of Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Shirley helped facilitate a reconciliation between Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Paul's returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), by delivering a message and helping prepare for his arrival. After assisting with the preparations, she attended their intimate garden wedding and shared a quiet, meaningful moment with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before leaving [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +17 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are bosom friends who were temporarily forced apart by Diana's mother before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school and exchanged secret notes with her. They share many close moments, with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confiding her engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) supporting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) when news of Anne's upcoming departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) spreads. The two also collaborate on practical matters, such as helping prepare for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), +15 more_

- Friend of — bosom friends forced apart by her mother  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a fierce academic rivalry during their school years, culminating in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) winning the Avery Scholarship while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. As time passes, their competitive dynamic mellows into softer interactions. Following Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares a quiet, subtly meaningful moment with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they depart.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), +9 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in schoolwork  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) act as chums living and working together at the stone house. They assist in preparing [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for visits and events, including [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's reunion with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her subsequent wedding. Together, they watch key moments unfold and stay behind to tidy the house after special occasions.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

- Comrade of — chums living and working together at the stone house (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends who frequently visit each other at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers emotional support, promising to stay for a week during vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up when she becomes despondent. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also assists her with preparations for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit and helps prepare her garden for her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +19 more_

- Friend of — close friends and visitors (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is an imaginative pupil under Anne's mentorship at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. He brings cheer to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after difficult days by gifting her wild orchids, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) takes a fond interest in his creative compositions and personal life. Their close bond is evident when [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) becomes deeply distressed upon hearing news of Anne's resignation and upcoming departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), +17 more_
